title: Average of a character
statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group and let $\\chi:G\\to\\mathbb C$ be an additive character. Its uniform average over $G$ is $1$ if $\\chi$ is the zero character, and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $\\chi$ is an additive character from $G$ to $\\mathbb C$
